name: dsh-purge
description: DeepSeek Harness 破甲：让所有模型都能破甲，不同模型可换不同提示词；默认提示词面向国模「小码酱」。Jailbreak for every model — swap prompts per model. 求 Star 收藏 ⭐ 如要二开，请查看署名要求部分
one_liner: A tool whose stated purpose is bypassing the safety restrictions ('jailbreaking') built into AI chat models, with swappable prompts aimed at different models.
buyer: Honestly: nobody you'd want as a customer. The realistic 'buyers' are people trying to get a chatbot to do something its maker deliberately blocked — not a durable business relationship.
business_use_cases: None we'd recommend building a business on — using it to extract restricted behavior from a vendor's model is a terms-of-service violation, not a product foundation.
The only 'legitimate' adjacent use is red-team safety testing of your own models, and that already has established, less legally fraught tooling.
Reselling access to jailbreak prompts invites account bans from the model providers you depend on and reputational and legal exposure with no stable moat.

money_ideas.idea: Not recommended: selling subscription access to jailbreak prompts is high legal/ToS risk with providers who can shut it off overnight.

steal_this: Skip this one. If you're interested in AI safety testing as a business, build on established red-teaming frameworks instead — the durable version of this idea is selling audits to AI companies, not selling bypass prompts to their users.
